snippet.title: Hexa Chippy | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
#AfilGames #HexaChippy
🐿️ Hexa Chippy – Launch Trailer 🌰
🎮 Available for Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation, and Microsoft Store starting November 12!
Guide adorable squirrels through handcrafted hexagonal puzzles — collect nuts, think fast, and enjoy the cozy challenge!

KEY FEATURES
🐿️ 30 levels filled with charm and challenge;
🐿️ Three cozy seasonal biomes: Spring, Summer and Autumn;
🐿️ Rotate and move tiles to connect paths and gather all the acorns;
🐿️ A clever hint system to keep you thinking without frustration;

Grab Yours 👇👇👇
🎮 Xbox One: https://x.gd/6ibTY
🎮 Xbox Series: https://x.gd/uU7obQ
💻 Microsoft Store: https://x.gd/FDr2Y
🎮 PlayStation EU: https://x.gd/lSWJh
🎮 PlayStation US: https://x.gd/CWaop
